name: Ahiezer
overview: Ahiezer is identified in Scripture as a significant leader from the tribe of Dan, serving as their captain during the wilderness encampment, as noted in Numbers where he is named the prince of Dan and responsible for a large host of over sixty-two thousand men. His role extended to spiritual leadership, demonstrated by his offering on behalf of his tribe at the tabernacle. Additionally, Ahiezer is recognized among the valiant warriors in David's time, highlighting his continued prominence and faithful service to God's people across different generations.
